description: This file defines a UI component named 'Button' using the LightningJS framework. It includes a template with dynamic text content based on the component's state, manages a favorited toggle state, and handles input to change that state.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A button component that toggles its 'favorited' state when the enter key is pressed.
